text.en: Clients frequently praise the Rothwell branch staff for their warm greeting and reassuring manner. Long-standing pet owners note that nurses and vets treat pets with genuine kindness during regular check-ups and difficult visits. While one reviewer expressed frustration with billing, the overwhelming majority describe a helpful and dedicated local team.

title.en: Gentle handling for cats and dogs

text.en: Pet owners highlight the gentle handling and patience shown towards nervous animals during clinic visits. Reviewers describe how staff take extra care to put dogs and cats at ease upon arrival, creating a calm atmosphere for routine consultations. Clients appreciate that animals are treated with genuine empathy throughout their examinations.

Reviewers appreciate the clear communication and thoughtful guidance provided by the clinical team in Rothwell. Pet parents mention that vets take time to understand their pet's individual needs and answer questions thoroughly. Clients note feeling supported and well informed regarding treatment options and preventive healthcare recommendations.

q.en: Does Abbey House Vets in Rothwell handle emergencies?

a.en: Routine consultations take place in Rothwell, while out-of-hours emergencies are directed to the main 24-hour veterinary hospital.

q.en: Is parking available at the Rothwell clinic?

a.en: Yes, the clinic has on-site parking available for clients visiting with their pets.

q.en: Can clients bring nervous or anxious pets for consultations?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the staff make an effort to put anxious dogs and cats at ease during appointments.

q.en: Are nurse clinics available at this branch?

a.en: Yes, the Rothwell surgery offers veterinary nurse appointments alongside routine vet consultations.
